 Netflix greenlights K-drama series The Twilight Between Us
 The Twilight Between Us stars Gang Dong-won and Kim Go-eun 
 Netflix has greenlit production of K-drama The Twilight Between Us, a romance-action period series previously known as Soul or Hon.
 The series comes from director Kim Won-suk (When Life Gives You Tangerines, Misaeng: Incomplete Life, Signal, My Mister) and writer Park Ji-eun (Queen of Tears, Crash Landing on You, Legends of the Blue Sea).
 The Twilight Between Us is being produced by Studio Dragon, Studio AA, Culture Depot, Baram Pictures and Imagyners.
 Starring Gang Dong-won and Kim Go-eun, The Twilight Between Us follows the heirs to two houses locked in a century-long feud, who are forced into marriage by royal decree. The union is intended by the king to end generations of conflict, but soon spirals in unforeseen directions.
 Meanwhile, Netflix has greenlit a spin-off from its South Korean competition format Culinary Class Wars, which will focus on singing rather than cooking.
 Vocal Class Wars pits two teams against each other: one comprising well-known singers and the other a group performing without their names or public personas who must earn their place on the strength of their voices alone.
 Vocal Class Wars comes from Studio Slam, the creator of Culinary Class Wars, and is slated to premiere next year.
 Karolina Kaminska
